task.title: Write a launch facts file
task.shortdesc: The facts file is the only input that changes from one generation to the next. It holds the values, units, short statements and tables the hardware team supplies, each with a source ID.

step.cmd: Set generation, product_key, topic_prefix and siblings, most recent generation first.
Under sources, give each source an ID such as S1, a title and a URL.
Under values, add one entry for each value, with its key, quantity, value, unit and source. Mark the values that belong in the specification table with table: spec.

info.p: Use the same quantity name for a value stated twice in different units. converts the units and turns a disagreement into a question.

step.cmd: Add statements and tables for facts that aren't single values. Write a value that has a key as {key}.
List topics that are new in this generation under new_topics, with the statements they should cover.
Run alignr draft --facts facts/<generation>.yaml --model baseline to check the file without calling a model.
